value.visualThesis: A friendly SaaS-style long-scroll B2B agency system for RankForge Kenya: dark violet photographic hero framing a light neutral body of badge-titled sections, an unusually tall asymmetric services card collection as the commercial core, narrative splits with floating metric-style chips, violet pill accordion FAQ, a photo-backed proof band, and dark conversion anchors (newsletter band + black contact banner into a dense dark footer). Violet is a low-to-mid frequency action accent, never a flood; surface shifts (dark hero → light gray bands with faint lavender tints → photographic mass → near-black bands) do the sequencing work.

signatureTraits.description: Full-bleed ~1.07-viewport hero (region-2) with a darkened collaborative-workspace photograph under a deep violet wash (dominant rgb(48,32,64) family), carrying the 60px Figtree display headline 'Get found when your customers are already searching.' and violet pill CTA 'Request an SEO Consultation'. CRITICAL: overlay must keep overlaid text at WCAG contrast; photographic background is darkened, never bright.

Header bar (~143px desktop) with a centered inline navigation strip of Poppins 15px/600 capitalize links and a distinct violet pill CTA at the header's right ('Request an SEO Consultation'); collapses to a compact mobile menu while keeping the pill CTA reachable.

Near-full-height (~0.97 viewport) light editorial split: large portrait-orientation photo of a practitioner at work inside a soft lavender circular/blob mask on the left, dense benefit/bullet copy on the right, Montserrat H2 with a small violet pill badge label.

The tallest region (~1.86 viewports) holds the six RankForge services as an asymmetric card collection: rows of 4-across icon cards, then 2-across wide cards, then another 4-across; equal white rounded cards with icon chips and small violet pill per-card actions. Row rhythm (4/2/4) must be preserved to avoid monotony across the long scroll.

Two sequential narrative split regions (~0.78 and ~0.97 viewports): one right-aligned image, one left-aligned montage, each pairing medium shots of a person at a device with copy and small floating chip cards. For RankForge, chips carry non-quantitative labels (e.g. process stage markers '01 Diagnose'–'04 Improve', service-focus tags) — no fabricated statistics.

Light ~0.8-viewport FAQ region with a left flat illustration montage (~90px displayed figures) and right-stacked accordion rows styled as saturated violet pills with trailing chevrons, first item expanded in dark text.

A ~0.48-viewport band whose background is a full-bleed real-office photograph (1440x630 mass, density ~0.79) with overlaid white rounded cards plus a dark accent card on the left half. For RankForge this becomes a 'why RankForge / positioning' proof band (principles, commercial-growth positioning) — photographic mass and overlay card composition preserved, but no invented testimonials or metrics.

Systemic rounded-pill violet buttons with small trailing arrow/plus glyphs used for every CTA and per-card action (accent violets rgb(142,45,226) / rgb(78,47,218) role anchors), plus small uppercase-style pill badges preceding each Montserrat H2.

fidelityPriorities: 1. Page silhouette and surface sequence — dark hero, light gray body bands with faint lavender tints, photographic mid-page mass, near-black band, dark footer; this alternation is the strongest identity carrier.
2. First viewport — dark violet photo hero with 60px display headline and violet pill CTA at ~1.07 viewport height.
3. Violet pill button/badge system — CTA geometry, per-card pills and badge labels appear everywhere; losing them dissolves the template voice.
4. Region topology and proportions — 12-section ordering including the ~1.86-viewport services collection and the two narrative splits.
5. Typography relationships — three-family stack (Figtree display, Montserrat H2, Poppins body/UI) with capitalize heading transforms and the compressed 40px sub-heading role.
6. Photographic grammar — darkened workplace backdrops, blob-masked portrait, medium person-at-device shots, flat illustration chips.
7. Component geometry — white rounded cards, icon chips, violet pill accordions, floating chip cards.
8. Responsive identity — all 12 sections retained on mobile via single-column stacking, photo-backed overlays preserved by cropping.

globalGrid.containerLogic: Full-bleed dark/photo surfaces (hero, photo-backed band, black contact banner, footer) span 100% viewport width; inner content constrained to a ~1200px centered container with ~40px desktop / ~24px mobile gutters. Card grids use a 4-column base collapsing to 2 then 1; splits use asymmetric 5/7 or 7/5 two-column layouts stacking image-over-copy on mobile.
columnRatios: centered single column (nav strip, newsletter, logo strip)

value.spacingRhythm: Sections breathe generously: light body bands use ~96-144px vertical padding; the tall services collection uses consistent ~64px internal row gaps with a repeated card-row rhythm (4/2/4); the compact newsletter band is deliberately tighter (~64-80px) as a fast conversion beat before the dense dark footer. Preserve the reference's irregular editorial rhythm — do not normalize all sections to one padding value.

typographyRoles.description: Figtree 700, 60px/78px desktop, capitalize, white on dark hero — 'Get found when your customers are already searching.' Scale to ~40px tablet, ~32px mobile.
Montserrat 700, 40px/48px, 0.8px letter-spacing, capitalize, typically preceded by a small violet pill badge label.
Compressed sub-heading role: Figtree 700, 40px/40px, 0.8px tracking — used for card titles and sub-block headings inside splits; drop to ~24-28px on mobile.
Poppins 400, 16px/22.4px, neutral gray rgb(55,65,81); max measure ~65-75ch in splits.
Poppins 600, 15px, capitalize — navigation links, pill CTA labels and badges.
Small Poppins labels for floating chips and badges; 12-14px, 600, capitalize.

colorRoles.description: Saturated violet (rgb(142,45,226) anchor) reserved for pill CTAs, badges, FAQ pills and icon chips — low-to-mid page frequency; never flood surfaces with it.
Deeper violet (rgb(78,47,218)) for hover/darker states and secondary accents.
Light neutral rgb(240,240,240)-family / body rgb(249,250,251) covers the majority of the page.
Faint lavender rgb(240,224,255) used sparingly as band tints and the portrait blob mask.
Near-black rgb(16,16,16) for the contact banner; rgb(48,32,64) violet-dark for the hero wash; dark footer bands (~rgb(80,80,80)/rgb(64,48,48)).
Body text rgb(55,65,81); white/near-white text on dark and photo surfaces.

value.surfaceLanguage: Flat, friendly SaaS surfaces: no gradients beyond the hero's dark violet photo overlay, no glassmorphism, minimal shadows (soft card elevation only). Cards are white, rounded (~12px), on light gray bands. Rounded-pill geometry is systemic for buttons, badges and accordion rows. One organic soft lavender blob mask for the about portrait. Dark regions are flat solid fills.
value.headerNavigation: Desktop header ~143px: logo left, centered inline nav strip of Poppins 15px/600 capitalize links, violet pill CTA fixed at right. Static-to-scrolled behavior: keep surface light/transparent over hero then solid on scroll. Mobile: compress header height, collapse nav into a compact menu while the pill CTA remains visible/reachable. All 14 nav items retained across breakpoints (no content removal).

homepageFirstViewport.summary: Header (~0.16 viewport) plus nav strip merge with the full-bleed dark violet photographic hero (region-2, ~1.07 viewports): darkened collaborative-workspace background, deep violet overlay wash, left-anchored 60px Figtree headline 'Get found when your customers are already searching.', supporting copy on technical SEO / content strategy / focused execution, primary violet pill CTA 'Request an SEO Consultation' and secondary 'Explore Our Services'. Overlaid text must retain WCAG contrast against the darkened photo. Mobile: same overlay composition, cropped image, stacked headline/CTAs.

homepageRegions.purpose: Header + centered inline nav + dark violet photo hero with display headline, supporting organic-visibility copy, primary 'Request an SEO Consultation' and secondary 'Explore Our Services' pill CTAs.

Light near-full-height editorial split introducing RankForge's approach: blob-masked portrait of a practitioner at work left, Montserrat H2 with violet badge and dense benefit bullets right ('SEO built around commercial growth, not vanity metrics').

Light strip with centered Montserrat heading and a horizontal row of five reduced-weight credibility markers. Adapted: no invented client logos — use desaturated generic capability/sector keyword marks (e.g. 'Local SEO', 'Ecommerce SEO') at reduced visual weight.

The commercial core: very tall asymmetric white-card collection presenting the six RankForge services (SEO Strategy, Technical SEO, Local SEO, SEO Content Strategy, Ecommerce SEO, SEO Audits) in 4-up icon-card / 2-up wide-card / 4-up rows with violet pill per-card actions.

Narrative split, image right: customer-problem copy (little qualified traffic, competitors above them on Google, unclear SEO strategy) paired with a person-at-device photo and floating chip cards carrying non-quantitative labels.
Mirrored narrative split, montage left: the four-stage process (01 Diagnose, 02 Prioritise, 03 Execute, 04 Improve) with floating stage-marker chips over imagery.
Light FAQ band: flat illustration montage left, violet pill accordion right answering common SEO questions (first item expanded).

Full-bleed office-photo band with overlaid white cards and a dark accent card on the left: RankForge positioning/principles (Commercial relevance, Technical clarity, Useful content, Continuous improvement) — no invented testimonials.
Compact conversion band with inline name/email fields wired to the WAZIBIZ Form Service; single tight beat before the footer.

Black full-width contact banner ('Ready to make organic search work harder for your business?' + 'Talk to RankForge') transitioning into a dense dark multi-column footer with navigation, services list, contact email and closing conversion beat.

imageSystem.photographyGrammar: Documentary-commercial photography of real work environments, not studio stock. People are shown candidly working at laptops/devices in clean office settings, usually one to two per frame, gaze toward task or occasionally camera. Warm-neutral to slightly warm grading, moderate contrast, restrained backgrounds with text-safe negative space where copy overlays imagery. Hero and proof-band backdrops are darkened under violet/neutral washes. Flat colorful illustration montages (not photography) accompany the FAQ. No macro product shots, no dramatic cinematic lighting, no desaturated editorial treatment, no hyper-saturated grading.

imageRoles.purpose: Full-bleed darkened collaborative-workspace photo as hero backdrop supporting overlaid display headline and pill CTAs under a deep violet wash; wide landscape, subject mass right-of-copy leaving text-safe left space.
Portrait-orientation (~2:3) medium shot of a single practitioner at a device inside a soft lavender blob/circle mask on a light surface.
Small square icon/illustration chips (~56-90px displayed) topping the six service cards; flat, colorful, consistent set.

Medium shots of a single person working at a laptop/tablet against clean light or lavender backgrounds, with floating chip cards; used in both narrative splits (one right-aligned, one left-aligned montage).
Flat illustration montage figures beside the FAQ accordion, square sources ~1:1, ~90px displayed elements composed as a small cluster.
Full-bleed real-office photograph (landscape ~1440x630) as backdrop for overlaid white cards and a dark accent card, darkened for overlay readability.

motionGrammar: Scroll-triggered reveal transitions for sections and card rows (substituting the reference's heavy parallax per the Adaptation Contract): fade + small upward travel, ~500ms, staggered ~80ms across card grids.
Floating chip cards in the narrative splits receive a subtle slower drift/offset relative to their parent imagery (reduced-motion-safe depth cue, no true parallax).
Violet pill buttons: background-color/darkening transition toward rgb(78,47,218) plus slight shadow lift on hover, ~300ms ease-out; visible focus ring for keyboard users.
FAQ accordion pills: smooth expand/collapse height transition ~300ms; chevron rotation; expanded row switches to light surface with dark text.
No structural motion: section topology stays stable under scroll; no horizontal scroll, no section reordering, no generic fade-up on every element.
responsiveContract: Breakpoints: desktop ≥1200px, tablet ~768-1199px, mobile <768px; mobile capture at 375px retains all sections and nav items — reflow, never removal.
Card grids: 4-across → 2-across (tablet) → single column (mobile), each card retaining its icon chip and pill action.
Split regions (about, narrative x2, FAQ) stack image above/below copy; the portrait scales down within its blob mask.
Header compresses; centered nav strip collapses into a compact mobile menu while the pill CTA stays reachable.
Full-bleed photo regions (hero, proof band) crop imagery while preserving overlay composition: stacked headline, overlaid cards retained.
Trust strip reduces from a 5-up row to a wrapped or scrollable smaller set.
No horizontal overflow at any breakpoint; no clipped critical content; type scales down per typographyRoles.
innerPageVocabulary: HERO_LIGHT_INNER — compact light inner-page hero with violet badge, Montserrat H2 and short intro; no dark banner on every inner page.
EDITORIAL_SPLIT — reusable 5:7 or 7:5 image/copy split extending the about-split language for About and service detail pages.
CARD_COLLECTION — the 4/2/4 (or simplified 3-up / 2-up) white-card grid with icon chips and pill actions for the six services.
PROCESS_SEQUENCE — numbered four-stage sequence (01 Diagnose … 04 Improve) using chip-card styling from the narrative splits.
ACCORDION_BAND — FAQ/violet-pill accordion section reusable on service and contact pages.
CONTACT_SPLIT — dark-accent contact area with WAZIBIZ Form Service form (Name, Company, Email, Phone, Website, help-topic select, Message) beside contact details.
QUIET_CTA — compact light conversion band with a single violet pill CTA.
NARROW_NARRATIVE — single narrow text column for principle/philosophy copy on About.
antiFallbackRules: Do not replace the 4/2/4 asymmetric services collection with a uniform 3-column card grid.
Do not remove the dark violet photographic hero in favor of a plain light hero.
Do not flood the page with violet; accent frequency must stay low-to-mid on a dominant light neutral body.
Do not replace pill buttons/badges/accordions with square or ghost buttons.
Do not invent testimonials, client logos, metrics or percentage chips — stat-style chips carry process stages and capability labels only.
Do not add gradients, glassmorphism or heavy shadows absent from the reference.
Do not default all imagery to centered subjects or sterile studio backgrounds; keep environmental office contexts.
Do not apply generic fade-up to every section; use the staggered reveal + chip-drift grammar only.
Do not shrink the services collection into a short strip; its ~1.86-viewport scale is identity-defining.
accessibilityAdaptations: All overlaid hero/proof-band text passes WCAG AA contrast via darkened photo washes; verified against the actual chosen imagery.
Visible keyboard focus rings on all pill CTAs, nav links and accordion controls; accordion rows are real buttons with aria-expanded.
FAQ accordion content available without hover; no hover-only essential behavior.
prefers-reduced-motion disables reveal travel, chip drift and long transitions while preserving visibility and state feedback.
Mobile body type never below 16px equivalent; nav and CTAs meet touch-target sizes.
Form labels, help-topic select and error states fully accessible; submission runs through the WAZIBIZ Form Service with Turnstile.
declaredLimitations: Adaptation Contract: reference heavy parallax replaced by reveal transitions and reduced-motion-safe chip-drift depth cues; macro composition and rhythm preserved statically.

Reference stat chips show metrics ('Taxa de Crescimento 45.80%'); business facts forbid quantitative claims, so chips carry non-quantitative process-stage and capability labels while preserving chip geometry and placement.
Reference testimonial cards over office photo become a positioning/principles proof band over the same photographic mass — no invented testimonials.
Reference client logos strip becomes a desaturated capability/sector keyword strip — no fabricated customer marks.
Exact reference font files not supplied; Figtree/Montserrat/Poppins used via closest legal web-font sources with declared fallback stacks.
No measured motion timing values from the reference; timing uses standard 300-500ms ease-out conventions declared here rather than copied measurements.
